title: R2 image key must persist returned key
expectedFix: Frontend saves the exact key returned by /api/upload-url, not a key derived from publicUrl.
verification: components/ImageGrid.tsx saves the exact key returned by /api/upload-url; app/api/me/images/route.ts validates key ownership and URL equality before creating the Image row.

title: JWT secrets must not fall back to change-me-in-production
expectedFix: Session signing secrets fail closed when required env vars are missing instead of using hard-coded fallback values.
verification: lib/auth.ts uses getRequiredEnv() for ADMIN_PASSWORD and SESSION_SECRET; missing values throw instead of falling back.

title: Docs must not recommend PRISMA_QUERY_ENGINE_LIBRARY on Vercel
expectedFix: README/docs state that PRISMA_QUERY_ENGINE_LIBRARY should not be set for this deployment path.
verification: README.md and docs no longer recommend setting PRISMA_QUERY_ENGINE_LIBRARY for Vercel; npm run audit:harness checks this.

title: Admin batch import is not transactional
expectedFix: Batch import creates all rows atomically or clearly reports partial success with a recovery path.
verification: app/api/admin/import/route.ts pre-generates account data and persists all Person + LocationCard rows inside prisma.$transaction; P2002 returns 409 and rolls back the batch.

title: Image count limit has a race window
expectedFix: Image count cap is enforced atomically or through a compensating cleanup path.
verification: app/api/me/images/route.ts performs the final image count, max sort lookup, and create inside a Serializable transaction with P2034 retry.

title: P2034 retry exhaustion returns 500 instead of 503
expectedFix: When all Serializable-transaction retries are exhausted due to P2034, the endpoint returns the explicit 503 retry-exhaustion response instead of throwing an unhandled 500.
verification: app/api/me/images/route.ts breaks out of the retry loop on the final P2034 attempt, allowing the 503 response to be returned.

title: Protected Admin credential was fixed in repository history and runtime bootstrap
expectedFix: Remove the repository-known password path and rotate the protected Admin through a one-time deployment secret without changing ordinary user credentials.
verification: The protected Admin requires a unique 16-128 character PROTECTED_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD, records PROTECTED_ADMIN_CREDENTIAL_V1_PROVISIONED, revokes prior sessions, and supports only audited single-account rotation afterward.

title: Processed media URLs bypassed current authorization and revocation
expectedFix: Authorize every processed media read against the current application session, submission state, group scope, and visibility settings.
verification: The Worker accepts only processed prefixes, calls the signed internal authorization endpoint before each read, fails closed, and returns private, no-store responses.

title: Production workflow used floating executable references and broad job secrets
expectedFix: Pin executable dependencies and expose production secrets only to the steps that consume them.
verification: GitHub Actions use full commit SHAs, Vercel CLI is pinned to 51.2.1, and database/Vercel secrets are step-scoped.
